description: Fires mainly in the first ~20 plies when the opponent has just dropped a stone low in column 1 (less often column 0, or column 2 as its first stone), provided I (side to move) have no stone in column 1 and few in column 4; my centre stones (col 4, also 3/5) and stacked column-1 stones suppress it. It almost never fires at ply 20-29; a separate, unexplained late-game (ply 30+) firing is not covered.
effect: None measurable: forcing it to max or zero changed move probabilities by at most 0.01 on 4 positions.
notes: Layer-0 unit, behaves like a token mixture (last-move column + which columns earlier stones were played in + position). Best dev F1 0.349 (P .349 R .349, AUROC .665), simulation share 0.17 (p7). Tried: last-col-1 rule (0.31), +no-mine-in-col1 (0.33), weighted column scores (0.29-0.33). Minimal pairs agree on the col-1/col-4 effects, but ~40% of firing (late game where col 1 is instead suppressive and col 3/5 fire; mid-game repeated 4,4/5,5 moves) is unexplained. Synthesis 0,6,2,6,1 reaches 1.120 > dev max 1.104.
